facts.text: The image is a vertical character reference sheet: a large rainy-night hero image spans the top, followed by front, side-profile and back turnaround panels, then close-up detail panels labeled face, jacket collar, hands and boots.

The reference sheet presents one adult person with short dark hair, shaved sides and a small topknot, wearing a black high-collared utility jacket, dark shirt, black cargo trousers and black combat boots.
In the top hero panel, the person stands upright with arms relaxed at the sides and head turned toward frame left on a rain-slicked rooftop or elevated walkway.
The hero environment includes metal railings, wet reflective pavement, visible rain streaks, a dark building facade and warm city lights in the background.
The FRONT panel shows the same person front-facing, standing with arms down; the SIDE PROFILE panel shows a left-facing profile; the BACK panel shows the person from behind.
The FACE close-up shows a neutral, serious expression, short shaved-side hair and a small scar-like mark through one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows a high black collar with straps and a metal buckle, and the HANDS detail shows two relaxed hands with slightly curled fingers.
The BOOTS detail shows black lace-up leather combat boots with scuffed, worn surfaces.
Visible panel labels read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.
